# Reviewed synthetic generator evidence

All example records are generated by this toolkit; no customer exports are used.
`baseline.json` records parameters, source/data/resource fingerprints, the complete
rule inventories and per-failure evidence from focus-validator 2.2.1. The `.log`
files contain its raw output. Rule expressions originate from the FinOps Foundation's
FOCUS models 1.2.0.1 and 1.3.0.1 (CC-BY-4.0; see the repository NOTICE).

Run `python scripts/validate_official_samples.py --check-existing` from the project
root to verify the archived evidence without the official dependency. Run the same
command without the option for a fresh reference comparison. A passing comparison
preserves known FAIL and SKIPPED results; it is not a conformance certificate.

See [generator corrections](../../../../docs/generator-corrections.md) for
interpretation, limitations and candidate review/promotion instructions.
